build_bert_bpe_encoder: build a python module that uses BertBPE to encode text into BPE tokens using a HuggingFace BertTokenizer
encode_text_with_bert_bpe: create a function that encodes a string into space-separated BPE tokens using the BertBPE encode method
decode_bert_bpe_tokens: create a function that decodes space-separated BPE tokens back into readable text using the BertBPE decode method
check_bpe_word_boundary: create a function that checks if a BPE token is the beginning of a word using is_beginning_of_word
configure_bert_bpe_cased: create a BertBPEConfig with bpe_cased set to True and a custom vocab file path
